armorFixture: assembly.json n2 identity; hidden original n5/n9 descendants; crest offsets applied
separationMethod: supporting planes over actual triangle vertices, model-root units

verification.scope: 252 discrete pose fixtures, not continuous animation or visual acceptance; body includes original retained body/head/crest and candidate helmet/skirt/belt plus legs, excludes intended arm/handle contact.
verification.method: For each tested pose, project every visible shield-surface triangle vertex and every visible body/leg or sword triangle vertex onto candidate axes, including oblique shield-frame directions. A strictly positive supporting-plane gap proves these complete mesh sets are disjoint. Hidden original helmet/skirt descendants are excluded.
verification.reversibility: Original arm/shield transforms, armor fixture visibility and crest transforms restore; repeated bind/OFF, damage-hidden shield, hidden-at-bind, handle release, sword independence and source GLB immutability pass.
